text:
anya: FYI - quick thread for Vela-v1 q5k anomalies observed on staging. Short list: JA/KO detok spacing (ZWSP-like gaps), AR paren mirror/swap, and a rare prefix echo when kvcache+batches>1.

kenji: can you drop a minimal repro + config?

anya: repro + config below. tokenizer tkv2 locale=on. quant=q5_k, kvcache=on, batch=6, max_seq=1024.

anya: ```
# JA sample
今日は、天気がいいですね。
POST /v1/generate {"model":"vela-v1","prompt":"<JA> 今日は、天気がいいですね。","quant":"q5_k"}
```

ali: q5k output (truncated):
` 今日 は 、 天 気 が い い で す ね 。` (note extra spaces). fp16 baseline has no gaps.

noah: Arabic example: input `قال: (هذا مثال)` -> q5k produced `قال: ）هذا مثال（` (paren positions swapped / fullwidth).

kenji: initial hypotheses: (A) quant noise moves neutral tokens across boundary so bidi transform flips, (B) detok normalization order applied after bidi shaping.

ali: ran token-id diff: ids diverge after pos ~12; pre-detok mapping table identical. So generation drift likely. But detok can amplify.

anya: metrics: JA BLEU 26.8->23.1 (fp16->q5k) on our 2k set; AR paren-preserve F1 .989->.912. Prefix-repeat seen 6/1000 in batched q5k, 0/1000 fp16.

deploy-bot: Canary staging job vela-staging-12 completed: 3 locale tests failed.

kenji: plan: run kernel parity (fp16 kernels on quant path), try q5k-shared centroids, and rerun detok pre/post ordering. Will push artifacts here. ETA 6h.

anya: action items: kenji run parity + q5k-shared, ali produce top-10 token divergences with bidi classes, noah hold canary if regressions exceed thresholds.

noah: holding rollouts until parity results. If q5k-shared reduces jitter we can consider opt-in.

kenji: kicking off jobs now (parity-9001, q5k-shared-9002). Will post logs and sample ids for prefix-repeat. :mag_right:
